notes.title: Update 0.3.2
notes.content:
In case you missed it, Update 0.3.2 went live on Friday. This time we added a new character, overhauled a game mode and more:

* Meet Donna Martin, the newest member of the YamaYama crew! 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21212372/2fe6af60f94af470ee2a1c5a760438bd4ddd50c1.png[/img]

* The game mode formerly known as Jello in my Belly has now received a graphical overhaul and is called Diaper Duty. Players but race to collect their diapers before their opponents get them - if an opponents gets it first, the diapers content gets poored over your head.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21212372/1ec9cef270ca4ee125a1d2b6b240b4b1836c3a55.jpg[/img]

* Graphics updated in end-round screen.

* Graphics for plus and minus (points) signs upgraded.

* Other minor fixes.

Let us know what you think!

notes.title: Update 0.3.1
notes.content:
Update 0.3.1 is now up and running. We updated a bunch of graphics, changed game modes and tidied up the tutorials. All the new stuff:

* Afterdeath items now affect the buttons in game modes played in King of the Mouth map:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21212372/6c0b3fc4bb71d426801d86cab33d7d54c619efc5.jpg[/img]
If you put the afterdeath item on top of the button the bridge will open, as if the button was pushed - more mayhem!

* New graphics and animations for every power-up when picked up, instead of simple icons above the player.

* The game mode previously known as Rainbow Jello is know I Like Big Bears, And I Cannot Lie as players seek to catch the pretty bear:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21212372/2317bc28932a41c4667ed703fd79a4873bae4c47.jpg[/img]

* Defend the Jello is now known as Houston, We Have a Penguin. You must fight to free the penguin in your color, that is tied to a rocket headed for space:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21212372/f2a1d2948d37ab2cdad56dced35fe59c2887f84e.jpg[/img]

* All tutorial graphics are up to date with new game modes.

* Minor fixes. 

Let us know what you think :)!

notes.title: Update 0.3 - New map & more
notes.content:
Update 0.3 is officially live and ready for the weekend! This is a big one, with a new map that drastically changes a few game modes. Here are all the features of the update: 

* King of the Mouth is a brand new map that features interactive buttons that collapse bridges or roll out slow zones.

* The new map allows you to play three of the older game modes in it - Last Man Standing (now Last Man Skating), It's A Bad Day (It's A Sad Day) and Yes, it's a Platypus! (Yes, it's a Breidnefur!). The game modes have new names in the King of the Mouth map, as they feel very different in this new environment with the interactive buttons.

* The flamingo in Pretty in Pink has been improved with animations.

* Now the game supports all resolutions, but forces them 16:9 scale.

* Comeback Kid achievement has been removed but 6 new achievements have been added.

* Other minor fixes.

We're really excited for the new map and looking forward to hearing what you think!

notes.title: Update 0.2.2 is up!
notes.content:
Newest update is out with new animation for the speedboost ability and a game mode about holding on to a flamingo!

* New speedboost animation.
* Pretty in Pink game mode - where you hold on to a flamingo until someone fatsuits you in to lava.
* Minor fixes.

We were previously hoping to add a new layout/level in this update, but it took a bit longer than we had planned. We're working on putting it up in the next update, coming next Friday!

notes.title: Update 0.2.1 is up & with a new game mode!
notes.content:
Our second post-release update is now up and running so here's what we were able to implement:

* New graphics for the portals in Islands level. 
* Barrel explosions in A Day at the Beach. 
* Fade in/out animations for castles in King of the Castle. 
* Move cycle for the platypus in Yes, it's a Platypus! 
* Animations for dash and impact. 
* Vibration/rumble for controllers. 
*** An all new game mode called Electric Feel!

Also some minor fixes were implemented. Now let us know in comments or in the discussions what you want for our next update that is coming in two weeks!

notes.title: Update 0.2 is out!
notes.content:
Update 0.2 is officially live and ready -  just in time for the weekend parties!  Here's what it features: 

* Tap to Explode is now called Bee 'em Up, where you have a beehive on your head as you try to get the bees to sting your enemies.
* A Day at the Beach has a cow with a dolphin head, sitting on a sun chair, shooting laser rays at anyone that comes to close to the waterfall.
* Animations put on monsters in all Dancefloor levels, where they start with an open mouth and then close it - so players cannot re-enter.
* Tutorials received an overhaul with regards to new graphics and text was simplified in some cases.

Check out screenshots on our [url=facebook.com/LumenoxGames] facebook page!	[/url]

Our next update is scheduled for Friday 29th of April. Let us know what [b] YOU 	[/b]want us to work on for that update, either here in comments or in the discussion forum!
